articles.content: The rupee is expected to fluctuate between Rs 94.5 and Rs 96 against the US dollar in the short term. A variety of factors affect the rupee's movement, indicating that no single factor can be pinpointed as the main influencer.

articles.title: Prestige Group drops Rs 2,700 cr IPO plan for hospitality arm, cites bad market conditions
articles.content: Realty firm Prestige Estates has withdrawn its IPO plan for its hotel business amid uncertain market conditions. The firm may consider reapplying for an IPO in the future based on market dynamics and necessary approvals.

articles.title: Rupee recovers as large public sector banks sell US dollars
articles.content: The Indian rupee appreciated by 15 paise, closing at 95.81 against the US dollar on Friday. This recovery was supported by actions from the Reserve Bank of India, which intervened in the currency market. The benchmark bond yield increased to 7.14%, the highest in four months, which influenced currency stability. Market analysts noted external financing requirements were putting pressure on the rupee's value.
